claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pivmecillinam is a prodrug of mecillinam, a beta-lactam that inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis; it has no activity against human cancer cells at 2.5 uM, so any apparent killing is expected to be absent or nonspecific.
